parameters.name: initial_inventory
parameters.description: Initial inventory of each crude type

parameters.name: selling_price
parameters.description: Selling price of each gasoline product

parameters.name: minimum_share
parameters.description: Minimum required share of the distinguished crude in each gasoline product

parameters.name: distinguished_crude
parameters.description: Distinguished crude type that must be present in every gasoline product

parameters.name: block_unit_cost
parameters.description: Unit purchase cost for each crude type and purchase block

parameters.name: block_capacity
parameters.description: Maximum purchasable quantity in each purchase block for each crude type

parameters.name: purchase_cap
parameters.description: Optional total purchase cap for each crude type

parameters.name: demand_upper_bound
parameters.description: Optional upper bound on demand or sales for each gasoline product

variables.name: purchase_quantity
variables.description: Purchase quantity from each block of each purchasable crude type

variables.name: blending_quantity
variables.description: Quantity of each crude type blended into each gasoline product

variables.name: production_quantity
variables.description: Production quantity of each gasoline product

constraints.name: nonnegative_purchase_quantity
constraints.description: Purchase quantities must be nonnegative for every purchasable crude type and purchase block.

constraints.name: nonnegative_blending_quantity
constraints.description: Blending quantities must be nonnegative for every crude type and gasoline product.

constraints.name: nonnegative_production_quantity
constraints.description: Production quantities must be nonnegative for every gasoline product.

constraints.name: minimum_share_of_distinguished_crude
constraints.description: For each gasoline product g, the distinguished crude r^\star must appear in the blend at least at share alpha_g of total production.

constraints.name: crude_availability_balance
constraints.description: For each crude type, total blending usage cannot exceed initial inventory plus purchases from all available blocks.

constraints.name: purchase_block_capacity
constraints.description: For each purchasable crude type and block, purchases cannot exceed the block capacity.

constraints.name: purchase_cap_limit
constraints.description: If a total purchase cap is provided, total purchases of each crude type across all blocks cannot exceed that cap.

constraints.name: demand_upper_bound
constraints.description: If demand upper bounds are provided, production of each gasoline product cannot exceed its demand limit.

constraints.name: production_definition
constraints.description: Total production of each gasoline product equals total blended crude input.

objectives.name: profit_maximization
objectives.description: Maximize total profit defined as gasoline sales revenue minus crude procurement cost

final_objective.description: Maximize total profit, defined as total gasoline sales revenue minus total crude procurement cost. The problem has a single clear objective, so no objective-combination method is needed beyond a single-objective formulation.
